basics.name: Calvin Nguyen
basics.label: Computer Science PhD Student
basics.summary: Computer Science PhD student researching geospatial machine learning, remote sensing, semantic segmentation, and computer vision.

work.position: Data Scientist, Geospatial ML & Remote Sensing
highlights: Developed a geospatial machine-learning pipeline for land/water classification and shoreline-change detection, supporting analysis of 2,909 shoreline miles across 39 North Carolina study areas and 93,017 measurement locations.

Developed and validated Guyana's PlanetScope-based shoreline classification workflow, achieving 97.9–99.2% accuracy across 300 bootstrapped evaluations and enabling erosion and accretion mapping along 682 km of coastline.
Created an experimental submerged-mudbank detection method using Canny edge detection and support vector machines on 50 cm satellite imagery.
Produced land/water segmentation for Biscayne Bay erosion analysis and assembled a property-level geospatial dataset.
Evaluated eight physical datasets and applied literature-derived rules within a prioritization analysis of 78 candidate Billion Oyster Project restoration sites.
Processed topo-bathymetric LiDAR, water-level datums, submerged aquatic vegetation, and soil-carbon data for coastal restoration planning.
Sorted and shelved library materials in alphabetic and numerical order.
Checked in materials using the library's automated computer system.
Boxed and unboxed materials and assisted library members with book donations.

volunteer.summary: Audited plant locations and labels, replaced stakes and labels, consulted on a deprecated database connector, and demonstrated RESTful API access to PostgreSQL/PostGIS.

publications.name: Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation of Thick/Thin Clouds and Cloud Shadows: A Comparative Study
publications.summary: Converts raw L8-Biome scenes into fixed 224 × 224 training splits and runs FMask, HQ-SAM, Prithvi, SatlasNet, and LSKNet/UNetFormer through Hydra-configured training and metric pipelines.

publications.name: Evaluating Geospatial Foundational Models for Cloud Segmentation: A Comparative Study of Performance, Calibration, and Representations
publications.summary: Routes 17 frozen geospatial encoders through a shared segmentation path and evaluates in- and out-of-distribution IoU, calibration, and representation metrics with controlled PyTorch Lightning and Hydra experiments.
